about.en: AMDon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Advanced Micro Devices, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by AMD shares and is a total-return tracker: it gives the economic exposure of holding AMD with dividends reinvested, so one token does not necessarily equal one share. It is deployed on Ethereum (0x0C1f3412A44Ff99E40bF14e06e5Ea321aE7B3938), BNB Chain, Solana and HyperEVM.
